# BCNLIP

> > BCNLIP is a Barcelona-based language school offering Spanish and Catalan courses, DELE/SIELE/CCSE exam preparation, student visa services, and housing assistance for international students.

Located in Barcelona's Gothic Quarter, BCNLIP (BCNLIP IDIOMAS S.L.U.) provides intensive and online language programs, conversational workshops, and specialized courses including Arraigo Social certification. The school supports international students with comprehensive visa services and accommodation options including homestays and student apartments.

## Key Topics

- Spanish courses in Barcelona
- DELE certification
- SIELE exam preparation
- CCSE (Spanish citizenship exam)
- Catalan language courses
- Student visa services for Spain
- Barcelona student housing
- Conversational Spanish workshops
- Online Spanish classes
- Arraigo Social certification
- Language immersion programs
- BCNLIP Foundation
- Gothic Quarter location
- Spanish language school accreditation
- International student support

- [Spanish Workshops](https://bcnlip.com/courses-2-2-2/spanish/workshops): Spanish workshop courses at BCNLIP Barcelona with DELE/SIELE/CCSE prep
- [Conversational Classes](https://bcnlip.com/courses-2-2/spanish/workshops/conversational): Spanish conversation practice workshops at BCNLIP language school
- [Online Spanish Courses](https://bcnlip.com/courses-2/other-options/online-classes): Hybrid format online Spanish courses at BCNLIP since 2020
- [Arraigo Social | Курсы каталонского и испанского языков](https://bcnlip.com/ru/arraigo-social-kursy-katalonskogo-i-ispanskogo-yazykov): 45-hour Catalan/Spanish courses for Arraigo Social certification in Barcelona
